site.name: João Pereira — Senior Mobile Developer
site.description: Portfolio of João Pereira, a senior mobile developer with 6+ years shipping production mobile apps across fintech, social networking, logistics and live streaming.

acceptedAnswer.text: João Pereira is a Senior Mobile Developer with over 6 years of experience building production React Native and TypeScript apps for fintech, social networking, logistics and live streaming platforms.

Taking mobile features from architecture to production: designing maintainable solutions, integrating APIs and native SDKs, handling platform-specific requirements and shipping reliable releases to the App Store and Google Play.

mainEntity.name: How many apps has he published?

acceptedAnswer.text: He has published 10+ apps across fintech, social networking, delivery and live streaming.

mainEntity.name: Is he available for new work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. He is open to freelance or contract work and to full-time roles. Reach him through the Contact screen, by email at joaovitorspereira@gmail.com, or with the book_intro tool of the MCP server.

mainEntity.name: Can an AI agent read this portfolio?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It exposes llms.txt, a JSON Resume file, WebMCP tools in the browser and a remote MCP server with the tools get_resume, get_projects, check_availability and book_intro.
